instructions: Complete the task delivered on stdin inside the governed sandbox and report the result.

files.template:
# Rendered by the platform before hermes starts (exec/v1 configuration.files).
# HERMES_HOME is the run's scratch home, because the image's /opt/data is on a
# read-only root filesystem. The model is the run's front, pinned to the granted
# model; the ONLY tool server is the run's own MCP tool service.
model:
  default: "${services.model.name}"
  provider: custom
  base_url: "${services.model.openai_base_url}"
  # Not a credential: the front drops Authorization before the model leg.
  api_key: andyur-front
  # The granted model is served with a 65536-token window. Stating it here
  # stops hermes probing the endpoint for it, which the front would refuse.
  context_length: 65536
  ollama_num_ctx: 65536
mcp_servers:
  andyur:
    url: "${services.tools.mcp_url}"
    headers:
      Authorization: "${services.tools.mcp_headers.Authorization}"
    timeout: 120
memory:
  memory_enabled: false
  user_profile_enabled: false
updates:
  check: false
telemetry:
  shared_metrics:
    enabled: false
    send: false
